command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "08e9ead56e41feff3dc26b55123db912582dd141"
test -z "$(git status --short)"
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh clean
GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA=08e9ead56e41feff3dc26b55123db912582dd141 bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build
grep -q 'GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA:STRING=08e9ead56e41feff3dc26b55123db912582dd141' build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/CMakeCache.txt
test -f build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/growbox_ml_controller.bin
test -z "$(git status --short)"
